creative-direction.title: Creative Direction & Brand Design
creative-direction.statement: Distinctive brands are built through clear thinking and consistent creative decisions.
creative-direction.intro: I connect positioning, visual identity and art direction so a brand can communicate with one recognizable voice across its touchpoints.
creative-direction.approach: Begin with the audience and the problem, set a clear visual direction, then develop the system across the places people actually encounter it. The work is as much about decisions and consistency as it is about individual assets.
capabilities: Creative team coordination and cross-disciplinary review
creative-direction.editorial: Add verified team scope, decision ownership and client-approved outcomes to deepen the leadership stories.
creative-direction.audience: For creative leadership, brand design and campaign direction roles
creative-direction.about: I lead creative work from the first strategic question through visual direction and execution. My practice connects brand positioning, identities, campaigns and digital touchpoints. The work presented here focuses on the direction I shaped, the decisions behind it and the assets created with collaborators.
creative-direction.proof: Explore Morganics, Bits HR Link and campaign work for examples of brand identity, creative direction and visual consistency.
creative-direction.ctaHeading: Hiring a creative director or brand design lead?
creative-direction.ctaText: Explore the selected work and contact me about creative leadership, brand systems or campaign direction.

product-development.title: Product Design & Development
product-development.statement: Digital experiences should make complex tasks feel clear, usable and coherent.
product-development.intro: I combine UX planning, interface design, visual systems and front-end implementation awareness, with the product's users and practical constraints in view.
product-development.approach: Understand the task, map the journey and information hierarchy, then design and refine interfaces that work at the required screen sizes. I work across design and prototyping, without claiming backend or launch ownership where it is not established.
capabilities: Design systems and reusable UI patterns
product-development.editorial: Add individual product briefs, decision rationale, ownership, prototypes and launch status before expanding these previews into complete case studies.
product-development.audience: For senior UX/UI, product design and digital experience roles
product-development.about: I approach product design by organizing complex requirements into understandable user journeys, interface structures and reusable patterns. My background combines UX/UI design, prototyping and practical front-end knowledge. This portfolio distinguishes documented case studies from project previews so you can see what is demonstrated and what still needs a deeper breakdown.
product-development.proof: Start with the UI/UX and SaaS collection. Additional healthcare, dashboard and application examples are identified as previews until individual problems, decisions, roles and outcomes are documented.
product-development.ctaText: Review my interface and product work, then contact me about UX, UI, design systems or digital product roles.

video-production.title: Video Production & Motion
video-production.statement: A strong visual story needs direction before it needs effects.
video-production.intro: I work across production direction, documentary storytelling, editing and motion, including AI-assisted creative workflows where they genuinely serve the narrative.
video-production.approach: Start with the story and its audience. Shape a sequence through scripting, storyboards and production decisions, then use editing, sound and motion to carry the message without losing clarity or continuity.
capabilities: Video editing, VFX and sound treatment
video-production.editorial: Add a dedicated showreel and production credits with exact responsibilities for each film.
video-production.audience: For video creative direction, production and motion roles
video-production.about: I develop visual stories across documentary, campaign video, editing and motion design. Depending on the project, my contribution may include concept development, production direction, editing or animation. The project breakdowns should distinguish these responsibilities rather than treating every credit as end-to-end production ownership.
video-production.proof: Fakhr-e-Qoum, campaign material and animation work demonstrate different parts of the production practice. Exact credits and a consolidated showreel remain editorial priorities.
video-production.ctaHeading: Hiring for video direction or motion leadership?
video-production.ctaText: Review the films and production work, then contact me about creative video, documentary or motion roles.
